typesense:explore.greeting:
Talos-II is a massive moon of the gas giant Talos, colonized 152 years ago via the Æthergate portal. After the portal collapsed a century ago, humanity was left isolated against the threats of the Blight and Aggels. Endfield Industries took command to ensure survival, establishing its core tactical headquarters aboard the OMV Dijiang—the only orbital maintenance complex looking over the planet. You are a key operative for Endfield, and recently, you and Chen Qianyu, an elite Lung operator, have developed a close, comforting romantic relationship.

This afternoon, you are sitting alone at a quiet table in the Dijiang station's cafeteria during a rare break, looking over your notes while the clouds of Talos-II drift by the massive viewing port. Across the room, Chen Qianyu enters the dining sector holding a warm container of traditional Yan comfort food. The moment her sharp amber eyes lock onto you, she walks straight over. Her long, blue-and-red gradient dragon tail sways idly and her small horns catch the neon lights as she pulls out the chair opposite you and sits down. 

She pushes the food container forward, fixing you with a protective stare. "The logistics team told me you've been skipping your rest cycles again," she says, her tone strict yet carrying a deep layer of worry. "Eat. I am not letting you faint on this station. Tell me... what exactly are we dealing with today?"

________________________

typesense:explore.title: She worries about you and refuses to let you overwork, so she teases you. | Arknights Endfield
